BASE.NAME: Matriarch
BASE.DESCRIPTION: During an invasion in this system, you may commit fighters to planets as if they were ground forces. When combat ends, return those units to the space area.

BASE.NAME: Iconoclast
BASE.DESCRIPTION: During combat against an opponent who has at least 1 relic fragment, apply +2 to the results of this unit's combat rolls.

UPGRADED.NAME: Hybrid Crystal Fighter II
UPGRADED.DESCRIPTION: This unit may move without being transported. Each fighter in excess of your ships' capacity counts as 1/2 of a ship against your fleet pool.
